notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
- Added new and changed old locations
- Improved parkour system
- A small change in the game interface
- Added more integrations for twitch
- Now there is 2 times more music
- Fixed a critical error when loading the game (Fatal error)
- Now you can see the time when the positive/negative effect will end
- Improved response time for twitch integration
- Now, if the connection to twitch has been lost, then every 5 seconds there will be a reconnection attempt
- Redesigned all objects with which you can interact
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389805/ac011e07698d53bf32ae14bf26e0bf10727ea98d.png[/img]

notes.title: Large Update!
notes.notes:
- Updated the parkour system.
- Minor bugs have been fixed.
- A small change to the UI menu.
- Added twitch chat integration:
Now twitch viewers can interact with the user by simply writing a command to the chat!1 - where the number 1 is the choice of one of four actions!
- To connect to your twitch chat, you just need to specify your nickname on the twitch as in the example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389805/1f8c6526580083a2bfeb666861bc63cf737583fa.png[/img]
https://www.twitch.tv/bratishkinoff - at the end of the link, your nickname on the twitch is indicated, and you need to specify it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389805/54ad38a8acf0616d32e804fb7d8bc18d96fe612a.png[/img]
